verdict.rationale: A paper, fax or mail fallback is a fair question for a government tax-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack publishes no mailing addresses, fax numbers or paper forms for completing tasks offline. The service-unavailability notice (at-financas-docs-12) only reports outages and gives no alternative channel. The postal-parcel item is about customs clearance of packages, not a filing fallback.

support.subject: As a founder, a paper, fax, or mail fallback rail is published with the exact addresses, numbers, and forms, so the task can still be completed when the online flow is unavailable
